title: Outstanding Oven Roasted British Beef Cornish Pasty
description: A cultured and energizing British dish featuring massaman curry paste and bonito-shave, all wrapped up in a traditional cornish pasty form, served on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced beef, massaman curry paste, and bonito flakes, mixing well.
Add the diced potatoes, onions, and carrots to the bowl, stirring to combine.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Spoon the beef and vegetable mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Place the pasty on a slate tile vessel and bake for 25 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
